newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Eastern HK float seen 10 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: China Eastern HK float seen 10 times subscribed.

text.p: The Hong Kong flotation of China Eastern Airlines Corp Ltd's H-shares is seen about 10 times subscribed at the close of its public subscription in Hong Kong on Friday, market sources said.
The shares are expected to be priced in the middle of the HK$1.22 to HK$1.38 range, they said.
H-shares are Hong Kong-listed shares of China-incorporated enterprises.
The airline operator is scheduled to make an official statement on the subscription results on February 4, with dealing in the shares expected to begin on February 5.
China Eastern offered 140 million H-shares, representing 10 percent of a global offering of 1.4 billion shares, in Hong Kong at a price ranging from HK$1.22 to HK$1.38 per share.
The global offering includes three tranches -- the Hong Kong public offering representing 10 percent of the total, and the U.S. and international offerings representing 45 percent each.
The company said about 60 percent of the net proceeds of the combined offering would be used to acquire new aircraft and related spare parts and equipment.
The balance will be used to finance construction of airport facilities at the new Pudong airport and additional maintenance facilities in Shanghai.
China Eastern operates 114 routes, 91 of them domestic. It has a fleet of 64 aircraft, including 41 jet passenger planes and one jet cargo plane.
